title: HKU Professoriate Recruitment (Business and Economics)
description:
The University of Hong Kong (HKU) is pleased to invite outstanding
scholars to contribute to our thriving research agenda as well as
to Hong Kong’s leading position in the region and beyond.

We will recruit 100 outstanding academics in emerging fields with
potential for scientific and scholarly breakthroughs—above and
beyond our existing recruitment programme—to join HKU as assistant,
associate, or full professors, on tenure-track or with direct
tenure.

This is an open-discipline call. Strategic recruitment areas in the
Faculty of Business and Economics include the following:

Accounting – Block Chain, New Economy Measurement, and Global
Regulation
Economics – Applied Economics, and Big Data Analytics
Finance – FinTech, Sustainable Finance, Entrepreneurial
Finance, and Household Finance
Innovation and Information Management – Business Analytics,
Digital Innovation, Information Systems, Operations Management, and
Business Statistics
Management and Strategy – Entrepreneurship, Innovation,
Regional Economy, Platform Economy, Digital Economy, Digital
Transformation, and Governance
Marketing – Quantitative Marketing: Digital Marketing, Big Data
Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behavior, and Social Media
Marketing

As a high-performing university with internationally recognised
strong global connections, HKU offers a stimulating and supportive
intellectual environment as well as a highly competitive
remuneration and benefits package. Locally and in the region, there
are many research collaboration and funding opportunities.

More information and application details are available at the
campaign website: https://www.prof-scholars.hku.hk/
. Interested applicants should apply online and provide a cover
letter, curriculum vitae, research statement, teaching statement, 2
or 3 most significant research publications, and contact
information for at least three references. Review of applications
is ongoing and the search will continue until the positions are
filled.

Advertised: Nov 6, 2020 (HK Time)
Applications close:
